messages:
anya: quick PSA — I pushed a tiny shim for KV eviction to handle concurrent deletes; opened PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4582
mike: linking the PR, thx
mike: can someone smoke this on staging? i saw intermittent 503s in continued rolling canary
anya: yeah noticed a flake in e2e when eviction raced with prefetch
ravi: what's the exact cmd to repro locally? i can run on my dev rig
anya: run:
```
$ ./scripts/run_local_infer --model small-qa --seq 512 --concurrency 8
# repro script triggers concurrent delete+prefetch
```
ravi: running now
ci-bot: build queued for runtime/pull/4582 — tests: unit, integration, e2e
mike: important detail — the shim returns empty KV rather than error during delete; I think some callers treat empty as cache-miss and issue heavy prefetch
anya: right, that doubles token load briefly and the canary hits prewarm limits
tara: if we fallback to old behavior (return error) callers backoff earlier — but that causes extra errors in logs. which is less bad?
anya: prefer no errors in logs for user-facing requests; but we need rate-limits so prefetch doesn't burst
ravi: local run shows a repeatable 2s tail latency when concurrency steps up to 6 — looks like batcher queueing
mike: can you paste the stack trace
ravi: here's the stack head:
```
runtime::Batcher::process_batch() +0x1a3
runtime::KVCache::get_or_prefetch() +0x8f
runtime::EvictShim::handle_delete() +0x45
```
anya: hmm evict shim holds eviction lock while calling notify to prefetch; that's the race. I'll push a fix to release before notify
mike: PTAL after you push — we want this merged before tomorrow's deploy window
anya: pushed fix, updated tests to add a small-multi-concurrency e2e case
ci-bot: build succeeded for runtime/pull/4582 (revision: 9b3f) — integration passed, e2e flaky (1/3)
ravi: e2e still flakes locally 1/5 runs; looks like timing-sensitive
tara: can we add a flakey guard: if prefetch queue length > 50, skip aggressive prefetch
anya: added conservative check; tests passing locally 10/10 for me
mike: thanks — i'll take a quick review now
ravi: left a couple nit comments about a comment typo
mike: LGTM aside from the typo
mike: merging after we green the next e2e run
ci-bot: e2e passed (2/3) — scheduling deploy candidate
anya: thanks all! if anyone sees regressions ping #incidents
mike: non-blocking: can we add telemetry to measure prefetch burst sizes? follow-up ticket
anya: opened ticket INF-722 in backlog
tara: thanks, will follow up on capacity plan
